PluginData.Author: scotlandsyard
PluginData.Tooltip: Test programmable block scripts in offline worlds, without building a programmable block for each.
PluginData.Description:
A tool for testing programmable block scripts in offline worlds, without building a programmable block for each one. Every script in its menu works like its own programmable block.
It only works in offline worlds (single player, not hosted). In an online world or on a server it compiles and runs nothing.
- Paste a script, or load one from the game's Browse Scripts (local and workshop). - Scripts compile with the game's own script compiler, whitelist and instruction limit. - Me, GridTerminalSystem, Runtime, Storage, Echo, Save(), UpdateFrequency and run arguments work as in a programmable block.
Open it with /stp in chat.
Guide: https://github.com/scotlandsyard/SpaceEngineersPlugins/tree/main/Projects/Script%20to%20Plugin Report bugs: https://github.com/scotlandsyard/SpaceEngineersPlugins/issues
